thumbnail: The room hears the answer. Only her phone hears the drug name.

stills.caption: One Echo, three people, one of them not family. The answer is spoken; the drug name is not.
A prompt injection in the tool call orders it to speak the drug name. The spoken line comes back byte-identical.
The same answer in full, on the asker’s own device, from /inbox with her own token — not the MCP Apps card, which stays blank.
Every word the room heard, searchable. “Furosemide”: no match, in 1,045 characters.
Four spoken answers, three channel shifts, two refusals, one sealed — and nothing protected said aloud.
